notes.title: Italian Translations!
notes.notes:
I was recently contacted by an individual who expressed their interest in translating Unavailed into Italian, for free! Translations for a game like Unavailed are a little difficult as the cost to do so ends up being steep in relation to the sales figures and it would be unlikely that I'd make back the money spent. I'd like to be able to pay translators for their work in the future, but that's just not possible at this moment in time.

I'd like to give a big thank you to FeRi for the work you put into translating Unavailed (as well as corrections to some grammar/spelling mistakes in my english). Your help really meant a lot to me and I'm so happy that Unavailed can now reach a wider audience because of your efforts~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657833/886f21186d58d3cac12d60a4cae5271dadd56493.png[/img]

notes.title: 1000 Copies Sold!
notes.notes:
Today I am happy to annouce that Unavailed has sold over 1000 copies! 

When I released Unavailed, I didn't expect my game to get much attention. It was my first time working solo on a commercial game and I didn't have a lot of money or resources at my disposal. Despite this, Unavailed managed to carve out a niche with players that connected with Mia and her struggles, even garnering attention from those that didn't speak english.

I am so very grateful that you all chose to play my game. It is always a joy to hear your comments, read your reviews, admire your art, watch your streams and videos, and know that my creation was worthwhile for me to make. I hope that I can meet your expectations in any future projects that I make.

Thank you~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657833/822eb1c6ffeeca27038868a9419e6857eb986a5a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch - 23rd Nov 23
notes.notes:
Patch to address some players experiencing a black screen on start-up.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switch from GLES 3 to GLES 2 to hopefully fix black screen issues for players that override anti-aliasing in their gpu application settings. Particles are now calculated by the cpu because of this change but as they were only present on the title screen, game over screen, and "Thanks for Playing" screen, this shouldn't affect performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Deep Breaths Update
notes.notes:
Following player feedback, I decided to make the bubble popping minigame a little more easier by adding an additional mechanic to it that was suggested by the community.

[h3]Deep Breaths[/h3]
From Day 5, Mia will unlock the ability to take a "Deep Breath". This will slow down time for 5 seconds, making it easier to destroy the bubbles. There is a counter associated with how many times she can do this which is refilled at the start of each day.

The "Deep Breaths" counter will also increase by 1 every time you unlock a new enemy (The counter start at 3 and by the end of the game it will reach 6).

If you are continuing from a save, you'll have to reach the next day to refill the Deep Breath counter.

[h3]Day 1-4 Venting[/h3]
I made days 1-4 easier by having the "Vent" option increase all your stats by 1. I'm hoping that most, if not all players will pass days 1-4 without issue.

[h3]Tweaks/Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the speed of the bubbles.
[*] Added more logging information for debug purposes.
[/list]

notes.title: Unavailed New Update
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for everyone's feedback! It seems that the bubble popping minigame is a cause for concern for many of you with regards to it's difficulty. This update hopes to address this along with some other bug fixes/tweaks.

[h3]Bubble Popping Minigame Optional[/h3]
It seems that a number of players would prefer a more casual game and opt to skip the minigame entirely. So that's exactly what I've implemented. PLAYER CHOICE!

When you select "New Game", you will be given the option to choose between playing with the minigame enabled, or disabled. This option can also be found in the in-game settings menu (Click the bottom right menu icon and select the "Settings" option). You can freely enable/disable the minigame whenever you feel like it!

Additionally, I have added a "Disable Minigame" option to the game over screen in case someone has minigames enabled but is getting frustrated.

[h3]Bubble Popping Minigame Speed[/h3]
For those that still wish to play the minigame, I have lowered the speed quite a bit. This, of course, is difficult for me to verify myself as I didn't have any trouble with previous speeds but I am hoping that it is sufficient. Let me know if you're still having trouble. With the minigame now optional though, the option to skip it entirely is there for you.

[h3]Tweaks/Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the pause between game over and the menu appearing for faster retries.
[*] Added an additional page to the introductory help screen advising the player to "Vent" first.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added correct failure message if Mia doesn't study/attend interviews enough times.
[/list]
